## Landed

- `exports/src/exports/record_basis.py` (new) — the Python half of the `sig.record-basis/1` contract: `record_basis`, `basis_rows`, `location_check_text` (closed `placement_check` vocabulary), `technology_text`, `evidence_text`, `CHECKED_BY_TEXT`.
- `exports/src/exports/provenance_panel.py` — `panel_from_statement(..., basis=)` + `panel_html` renders the basis `<section>` inside the one `<details>` (marker attribute preserved — single emitter).
- `exports/src/exports/release_pages.py` — `/r/` record pages pass `record_basis(record.dedup, …)` into each claim panel (per-claim evidence line from the statement's binding).
- `exports/src/exports/dossier_sources.py` — `dedup_colocated` on the contribution plan: unique cross-source possible-duplicate pairs per dossier from `DedupView.possible` (bounded list + `truncated`); `cross_source.colocated_pairs` + `totals.cross_source_colocated_candidates` measured; the `observation_group` `not_evaluable` placeholder and its definition text replaced.
- `web/src/lib/record-basis.ts` (new) — the TS twin: `recordBasis`, `basisRows`, `locationCheckText`, `technologyText`, `evidenceText`, `CHECKED_BY_TEXT`.
- `web/src/components/RecordBasisRows.tsx` (new) — the one basis block's row markup shared by `ProvenancePanel.tsx` and the `/map/` island twin `claim-panels.tsx` (UXR-33).
- `web/src/lib/provenance-panel.ts` — `ProvenancePanelData.basis`; `panelForClaim(..., basisIndex)` resolves `entity_id → basis` so the same claim renders the same block everywhere.
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getRecordBasisIndex()` (export: compartment `sites.jsonl` rows; fixtures: `MAP_ASSETS` carrying the dedup fields) + `getMapCountInterval()` (`web/map.json` `count_interval`).
- `web/src/lib/map.ts` — `MapAsset` gains the optional dedup fields + `placementCheck`.
- `web/src/islands/map/model.ts` — `MapRecord.basis`, `SelectionPanelModel.basis` (`SelectionBasis` = corroboration text + optional full block + `interimOnly`); `selectionFromTileProps` derives the interim `st`-wording, never a fabricated basis.
- `web/src/islands/map/MapApp.tsx` — the selection `<dl>` renders Corroboration + Quality basis rows.
- `web/src/pages/map.astro` — `ISLAND_RECORDS` carry `basis`; the map interval line renders `count_interval.display` verbatim with a `/quality/#duplicates` link.
- `web/src/pages/{entity/[type]/[key]/index.astro,evidence/claim/[id].astro,explore/index.astro,watch/item/[handle].astro}` — `panelForClaim` call sites pass `getRecordBasisIndex()`.
- `web/src/lib/dossier-sources.ts` — `ColocatedPair`, `cross_source.colocated`/`colocated_truncated`, `totals.count_interval` typed.
- `web/src/components/DossierSourcesExplorer.astro` — measured co-located count + `<details>` pair list (verbatim L3 §5.2 displays); the `Listed cameras` interval row beside the totals.
